rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the context makes clear whether the assimilation is cultural or phonetic.

example.english: After several generations in Hong Kong, they gradually underwent assimilation.
example.traditional: 佢哋搬咗嚟香港幾代，慢慢同化咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bun1 zo2 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 gei2 doi6 maan6 maan2 tung4 faa3 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a minority group adopting the customs and attitudes of a dominant culture.

example.english: The minority group experienced cultural assimilation under the influence of mainstream society.
example.traditional: 少數族群喺主流社會影響下出現文化同化。
example.jyutping: siu2 sou3 zuk6 kwan4 hai2 zyu2 lau4 se5 wui2 jing2 hoeng2 haa6 ceot1 jin6 man4 faa3 tung4 faa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a sound change in which one speech sound becomes more like another.

example.english: This sound change can be explained by assimilation.
example.traditional: 呢個音變現象可以用語音同化解釋。
example.jyutping: ne1 go3 jam1 bin3 jin6 zoeng6 ho2 ji5 jung6 jyu5 jam1 tung4 faa3 gaai2 sik1
